cards.name: Direct Data Cylinder
cards.summary: Symbol 'Direct Data Cylinder' from Illustrator's Illuminate Flow Charts symbol library: a glossy blue drum lying on its side, with a pale aqua top, a darker band across the middle and an open elliptical end ring on the right; the flowchart shape for direct-access data. use_for: databases and data stores in system diagrams
avoid: text on its own: the shape holds no label; add one with the Type tool
a flat or print-friendly look: the glossy aqua-blue gradient is baked in; break the link and set a flat fill for one-colour work
print-size use at natural size: it is only about 28 x 23 pt; scale it up (the gradients are vector and stay smooth)
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Illuminate Flow Charts; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Direct Data Cylinder")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Illuminate Flow Charts.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Glossy blue drum on its side with an aqua top, darker middle band and an open elliptical end ring at the right.
